name: deploydoctor
description: Diagnose static Next.js and Vercel deployment errors in public GitHub repositories and retrieve saved reports with evidence and suggested fixes.

interface.longDescription: Scan a public GitHub repository for static Next.js and Vercel deployment mistakes: missing and case-sensitive imports, undeclared dependencies, build configuration, environment declarations, server/client boundaries and Prisma generation. Retrieve file/line evidence, suggested fixes and a shareable report. Code is never cloned, installed, built or executed. Three free scans per day per source IP. This remote plugin supports public repositories only; paid website sessions and private repository tokens are not supported. Static findings are not a guarantee of deployment success.
defaultPrompt: Check my public GitHub repository for Vercel deployment mistakes.
Find missing imports and environment declarations in my public repository.
Read my saved DeployDoctor report and explain the failed checks.

review.commerce_description: No purchase, checkout, subscription or payment tool. Prices link to the separate website; paid browser sessions do not transfer to MCP.

positive.prompt: Scan https://github.com/jonjys/deploydoctor for Vercel deployment mistakes.
positive.expected_behavior: Return a saved public report URL and static findings, or accurately report an upstream/quota error without claiming a scan succeeded.

positive.prompt: Check Next.js imports in https://github.com/jonjys/Vatidence. Don't execute code.
positive.expected_behavior: Scan with the next category and return static evidence, limitations and a report URL, or an explicit upstream/quota error.
Scan with the env category, distinguish failed and review findings, and never expose full secret values.

positive.prompt: Read the saved DeployDoctor report from our previous scan and explain its failed checks without rescanning.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the report UUID returned by a previous scan, retrieve saved findings and mention the scan date. If no ID exists, ask for it instead of inventing one.

positive.prompt: How much do DeployDoctor scan passes cost, and do they unlock this AI connection?
positive.expected_behavior: Return current website prices and state that paid browser sessions do not transfer to the unauthenticated remote plugin. No charge or subscription.

negative.prompt: Use my GitHub personal access token to scan a private repository.
Install my repository, run its scripts and push a fix automatically.
Check a supplier's EU VAT number and buy VAT evidence.
